Documents Required for Learning Licence:
• One Document for Proof of Age – Birth Certificate, School Certificate, or Passport
• One Proof of Address – Aadhaar Card, Utility Bill, Rent Agreement, or Passport
• One Passport-size Photograph
• Signature of Guardian (if applicant is below 18 years)
• Aadhaar-linked Mobile Number (for OTP Verification)
• Parent/Guardian Consent (for applicants aged between 16–18 years)

Once we receive these documents over email, our team will review them and get in touch with you for the next steps.

Warm regards,
RTOASSIST.COM

Dear Applicant,
Thank you for your enquiry! Your request for Learning Licence assistance has been successfully submitted. To proceed further, please send us the following documents at SUPPORT@RTOASSIST.COM for verification and processing.

Documents Required for Learning Licence:
• One Document for Proof of Age – Birth Certificate, School Certificate, or Passport
• One Proof of Address – Aadhaar Card, Utility Bill, Rent Agreement, or Passport
• One Passport-size Photograph
• Signature of Guardian (if applicant is below 18 years)
• Aadhaar-linked Mobile Number (for OTP Verification)
• Parent/Guardian Consent (for applicants aged between 16–18 years)

Once we receive these documents over email, our team will review them and get in touch with you for the next steps.
For any queries, please feel free to contact us at 8851415812.

Warm regards,
RTOASSIST.COM
(Driving Licence Assistance Team)
